company.name: Abjjad
company.shortDescription: SaaS, Mobile App, eBooks, Arabic Language, Digital Publishing, Subscription Model
company.description:
Abjjad is an innovative tech company headquartered in Amman, Jordan, focused on reshaping the landscape of Arabic literature and reading experiences. Our flagship mobile app introduces a transformative way of engaging with literature, featuring a comprehensive collection of over 20,000 Arabic eBooks. With a seamless blend of technology and culture, Abjjad offers readers the opportunity to immerse themselves in a diverse range of literary works.

The Abjjad app is designed to provide users with an authentic and enjoyable reading experience that mirrors the feel of a traditional paper book. Through intuitive features such as page-flipping and highlighting, readers can interact with content in a familiar yet modern manner. Our platform also fosters a sense of community by connecting over 1.5 million passionate readers, enabling them to share insights, reviews, and recommendations.

At Abjjad, we're committed to enhancing accessibility to Arabic literature and nurturing a love for reading. Our subscription model unlocks unlimited access to our expansive eBook library, allowing readers to explore a wide array of genres including stories, novels, biographies, philosophy, psychology, history, politics, religion, and self-help. Abjjad's subscription model has been meticulously crafted to provide convenience and value, inviting users to embark on a literary journey at their own pace.

By marrying technology with the rich literary heritage of the Arab world, Abjjad is paving the way for a new era of reading. Our mission is to empower readers with a platform that transcends borders and brings together people who share a passion for learning and self-discovery. As we continue to expand our library and enhance user experiences, we invite potential investors to explore the potential of Abjjad and join us in shaping the future of literary engagement.
